9: Community not public: Location not available
21: Community not public: Less than 15 AEDC children valid
22: Community not public: Less than 2 teachers reporting for the Community
23: Community not public: Less than 15 AEDC children valid and less than 2 teachers reporting for the Community
rationale: CPublic is a published 2-digit reason code, not a yes/no flag; the dictionary lists all seven values.
